principle: Read, refresh and poll paths must not mutate durable state merely because observation occurred.
forbidden_read_side_effects: lease renewal caused only by read

targets.authority_note: Projection only; atomic CREATE claim remains authority.
Packet projection is immutable after arm.
Status is derived projection, not liveness owner.
refresh/load/readCache may fetch/cache locally but must not create durable coordination writes.
Compiled context references owners; it is not an owner.
Reading receipts must not emit new receipt/progress events.

certification_rule: A target becomes PASS only after its concrete implementation is inspected or exercised and no durable write-on-read path is observed.
missing_source_rule: UNKNOWN_OR_UNAVAILABLE, never numeric zero and never fresh.
